plugins.name: aims
plugins.description: Makes design the goal of coding-agent work and makes the design knowledge durable: a design method files ADRs, requirements, components, and insights into records co-located with the code, so a later clean session reads prior conclusions instead of re-deriving. One advisory read-time drift hook; nothing in the background. Commands: /aims-plan, /aims-build, /aims-review, /aims-plan-and-build, /install-on.
